name: Look Around
objectives: Search the Abandoned House for supplies
Pick up the Axe
Tune the radio until the caller's conversation starts
Board the motorboat and sail west to the Trading Post
walkthrough: Loot the house before leaving — Metal Plates and Rope become useful almost immediately, and the Axe is required later for Coral Fibers. Tune the radio until the objective advances, then sail west and moor at the Trading Post dock.

name: You're Not Welcome Here
prerequisites: Accept the Essence treatment at Betsy and Sons
Collect the chest from the pier
objectives: Carry the chest into the Bunkhouse and place it in the marked position
Patch the hole in the wall with the available material
Sleep until morning
Collect the Simple Rod
walkthrough: The objective chain does not advance until the chest is inside and the wall is patched. After sleeping, Gill and Bozur contact you with the first fishing assignment — do not leave without the Simple Rod.

name: Catch Peaceful Fish
objectives: Equip the Simple Rod and Earthworm at the fishing platform
Catch five Snappers
Keep all five whole and deliver them to Gill and Bozur
walkthrough: Cast into the active water and keep the rod still until a Snapper bites. Pull opposite the fish to drain Stamina, reel when it tires, and stop reeling before Line Tension fills. Do not process or sell contract fish.

name: Moonshine Still
objectives: Inspect the Moonshine Still and remove the prosthetic leg lodged inside
Gather Coral Fibers at Angler's Island with the Axe
Gather Bug Slime from the small blue creatures with the Hook Gun
Gather Metal Plates from floating salvage
Repair the still with the requested quantities
Speak to John again
walkthrough: The prosthetic leg must be removed before the repair prompt progresses. Keep spare Bug Slime — the Dry Dock hull repair consumes it too.

name: Dry Dock Repairs
objectives: Feed the Fuel Larva with Fish Meat and fill the boat with the Fuel Gun
Repair the Fuse Box with 1 Cable
Flip the separate Power Switch
Raise the boat on the Boat Lift
Pressurize the cleaning system with the Pressure Pump and remove the Polyps with the Water Cannon
Load Bug Slime into the Repair Gun and repair every damaged hull section
Report to John
walkthrough: Producing fuel and filling the tank are separate actions. The Fuse Box repair and the Power Switch are two different interactions — if the equipment stays dead, check both. Inspect each hull section individually.

name: Hull Protection
prerequisites: Wind-Up Tin blueprint from Gill and Bozur
objectives: Catch three Softgrazers at the peaceful fishing grounds
Process them at the Thresher for Chromatic Scales
Bring John the scales
Research Weak Hull Protection and the Upgraded Engine
Craft Hull Protection at John's Lathe (3× Coral Fibers, 2× Bug Slime, 2× Rope, 2× Rubber)
Install it in the side-front mounting slot
walkthrough: Keep the three Softgrazers whole until processed. If the crafted module is missing from your inventory, check the Dry Dock storage locker before crafting a second copy.

name: Install the Upgraded Engine
prerequisites: Deliver three Harpooners to Gill and Bozur
objectives: Craft Rainbow Fin at the workbench
Catch three Harpooners at the predator splash zone and deliver them
Buy the Carburetor from Betsy and Sons for 50
Raise the boat and remove the Standard Engine
Craft the Upgraded Engine at the Lathe (10× Metal Plate, 4× Gear, 2× Machine Oil, 1× Carburetor)
Install it in the empty engine mount
walkthrough: The contract unlocks the shop listing — the Carburetor does not appear automatically. Cast Rainbow Fin into a splash zone and retrieve steadily; reeling too fast or leaving the lure still both end the chase.

name: Open the Gates of the Throat
objectives: Refuel and start the Generator (a Fuel Can is nearby)
Try the Gate Control
Install the Thermal Coil in the damaged electrical assembly
Install the replacement Gear in the designated slot
Install both Buckets on the water-wheel mounting points
Repair the damaged Water Pump in place
Use the water-flow controls and blue pivots to route water to both wheels
Wait for both wheels to turn, then open the gate
rewards: Passage out of the region (demo completion)
walkthrough: 'Repair machinery' means a missing Coil, Gear, Bucket or pump repair; 'configure water flow' means the channel controls, not the generator. One turning wheel is not enough — both must spin before the Gate Control works.
